\begin{document}
In the Boltzmann equation, $f^{0}(\epsilon)$ denotes the equilibrium Fermi distribution at chemical
potential zero. Under $\epsilon \to -\epsilon$ the equilibrium distribution changes sign,
\begin{equation}
f^{0}(-\epsilon) = -f^{0}(\epsilon) .
\label{eq:odd}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
